name: TimelyCare
one_liner: Virtual counseling, 24/7 TalkNow mental health support and medical visits for students whose school subscribes to TimelyCare.
best_for: College students whose school offers TimelyCare and want counseling without a campus waitlist
Students who need same-day emotional support at night or on weekends (TalkNow)
Students who want medical and mental health visits in one app
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People whose school does not subscribe to TimelyCare
Students who need intensive or in-person treatment
short_description: Telehealth for students, paid for by their college: scheduled counseling, 24/7 on-demand mental health support, medical visits and peer community.
long_description: TimelyCare, run by Timely Telehealth, provides virtual care to students through contracts with colleges (and some K-12 programs). Depending on what the school buys, students can book scheduled counseling with a licensed counselor, use TalkNow for on-demand emotional support at any hour, see a medical provider on demand or by appointment, and join workshops and an anonymous peer community; the App Store listing also lists psychiatric care, health and success coaching and basic-needs help. Students sign up with their school email in the app or on the web, and school pages describe the services as free to enrolled students. Students under 18 register by phone with a parent or guardian. TimelyCare's privacy disclosures say that data from its general website is sold or shared with third-party marketers and analytics providers, while app data is listed as not sold; medical information falls under a separate HIPAA notice.

pricing.notes: Paid for by the student's college; services and session limits depend on the school's plan. The App Store listing also shows an in-app purchase called 'TimelyCare Monthly' at $19.99; what it covers is not explained.

privacy.notes: Its disclosures say data from the general website is sold or shared with third-party marketers (app data listed as not sold); medical records fall under a HIPAA notice.

faqs.q: What is TimelyCare and who is it for?
faqs.a: TimelyCare is a digital health platform designed to support mental health and wellness.
TimelyCare pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.
Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Scheduled counseling with a licensed counselor

patient_summary: If your college offers TimelyCare, you create an account with your school email and can book counseling, talk to someone right away through TalkNow at any hour, or see a medical provider by video. Your school pays, so there is usually no cost to you. What you can use (and how many counseling sessions) depends on your school's plan.

availability.note: Only for students at colleges (and some K-12 programs) that subscribe; sign up with your school email. Under-18s register with a parent or guardian.
